hooks.command: repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$repo_root/scripts/check-records.mjs" ] || exit 0; cd "$repo_root" && node "scripts/check-records.mjs" --hook
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$repoRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$repoRoot)) { exit 0 }; $runner = Join-Path $repoRoot 'scripts/check-records.mjs'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner -PathType Leaf)) { exit 0 }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $repoRoot; node $runner --hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
